title: Teluni Risks and Dependencies
html:
Project documentation · Architecture choices · Human actions

This register owns product-delivery risks identified from the owner's brief and the repository baseline. They are prospective risks, not claims of discovered production vulnerabilities. Tasks own implementation progress; human actions own actual owner decisions/access. Review this register at each phase gate and after pilot evidence changes assumptions.

ID Risk / consequence Mitigation and verification Dependency / activation
R-01 Cross-tenant or branch leakage exposes private media or allows unauthorized publication Threat-model data/reference/cache/media boundaries; negative API and database tests before first tenant slice D-01/D-02; PJ-03/PJ-08
R-02 Interrupted publication, storage exhaustion or power loss corrupts programming Immutable staging, verified assets and durable generation recovery; real power/network tests D-04/D-05; PJ-09/PJ-11/PJ-12
R-03 Offline operation preserves revoked or commercially expired content Explicit offline authorization envelope, expiry/default policy and honest unreachable-device state; test expiry and reconnect D-03/D-06; PH-09
R-04 Android TV models differ in codecs, storage, orientation and unattended reboot/startup behavior Agree supported hardware/profile/update matrix and test physical devices before support promises D-07; PH-08; PJ-12
R-05 Residential power, internet/CGNAT, ISP or disk failures make administration/distribution unavailable Verify network/host capability and secure ingress, communicate pilot limits, exercise offline continuity and plan funded migration D-08; PH-10; PJ-13
R-06 Database-only or same-host backups cannot restore complete publications after host loss Off-host protected database-plus-media backups, consistency/revocation/deletion reconciliation and timed isolated restore PH-10/PH-13; PJ-13
R-07 Identity/provider or device-credential mistakes create abuse or unrecoverable enrollment Established protocols, scoped identities, recovery/revocation design, race/rate-limit tests; no custom crypto D-02/D-03; PH-11
R-08 Video traffic/storage/processing and manual support exceed affordable costs Measure upload/download/storage and support burden; local replay avoids repeated streaming but first downloads/updates still consume uplink PH-12; PJ-14
R-09 The single candidate pilot biases the product or has unconfirmed demand Validate core journeys with the snack bar and later other segments; keep specialized capabilities outside core PH-08; PJ-14
R-10 Unverified domain/trademark status, copyright attribution, proprietary material or privacy obligations delay distribution Apache-2.0 and Connected Tiles selected; Teluni/teluni.app direction approved and the visual identity integrated. Domain control and trademark outcomes still require evidence. Preserve inherited rights, confirmed attribution and privacy obligations; no unauthorized PDT Display reuse PH-06/PH-07/PH-13/PH-14
R-11 Old/offline players cannot interpret new manifests or reconnect after a host move Explicit compatibility window, endpoint overlap, controlled app update/recovery and migration rehearsal D-04/D-07/D-08; PJ-11/PJ-12/PJ-13
R-12 Expanded initial scope exceeds delivery, renderer or host capacity Preserve approved capabilities while delivering coherent slices, qualifying real profiles and separating future widgets/integrations; no mandatory paid AI/ERP dependency D-06/D-11; release targets; PJ-15/PJ-16/PJ-20/PJ-21
R-13 Incorrect time/locale handling displays wrong schedules or prices Zone-aware shared fixtures, exact monetary semantics and localized presentation separated from rules D-06/D-10/D-11; PJ-10/PJ-20/PJ-21
R-14 Proposals, inherited CI configuration or written requirements are mistaken for working product/remote acceptance Explicit status vocabulary, code-based baseline, local gate evidence and separate remote/hardware/pilot verification PJ-01; phase gates
R-15 Existing high-severity source-map-js advisory may expose affected source-map processing to event-loop denial of service Triage Dependabot alert #1, identify affected dependency paths and validate a compatible fix; controls are active but this alert remains open as of 2026-10-17 PJ-18; outside the licensing/security-activation change
R-16 Concurrent content exceeds the supported player's rendering, decoding or memory capacity Qualify the selected reference target, review the rendering/publication model and test offline playback/recovery before claiming supported FR-10 delivery D-04/D-07/D-11; PH-08; PJ-12/PJ-20
R-17 Custom fields/imports or destructive schema evolution expose data, execute unsafe content or break published bindings Typed bounded validation, stable field/schema versions, scoped references and negative import/evolution tests; no arbitrary code/SQL D-01/D-11; ADR-0023; PJ-03/PJ-20/PJ-21
R-18 Automatic price publication leaks drafts or delivers stale/incorrect effective prices Authorized durable versioned intent from published dependencies, explicit queued/failed/active states, concurrency/idempotency/reordering and promotion-validity tests; reject complete out-of-scope mutations, distinguish approved proposals from effective saves and revalidate pending effects D-02/D-04/D-10/D-11; PJ-11/PJ-21/PJ-24
R-19 Public automatic signup enables resource abuse or premature commercial/data commitments Verified new-tenant enrollment, contextual limits, no existing-company claims, approved activation entitlements/notices and measured costs before opening registration PH-12/PH-13/PH-15–PH-17; PJ-03/PJ-24
R-20 Default provider tokens, editable principal attributes or weak recovery bypass the application identity/assurance contract Pin/qualify provider settings and immutable human-principal mapping; validate trusted session/assurance context, linking and recovery; no JWT weakening D-02; ADR-0024; PH-11; PJ-24
R-21 Stale sessions/grants, shared resources or approval races distribute content beyond authorized targets Current scoped application state, 30-second revocation bound, sensitive-effect revalidation, IA-01–IA-16 allow/deny cases and real-actor support audit D-02; ADR-0025; PJ-03/PJ-24
R-22 Self-hosted identity or unavailable mail prevents login/recovery or exceeds the residential budget Measure host capacity, protect provider management, qualify independent recovery/restore and verified email; no unfunded provider/free-tier assumption PH-10/PH-15/PH-17; PJ-13/PJ-24

No numeric probability, severity score, SLA, cost ceiling or residual-risk acceptance is fabricated. Quantify these when pilot/hardware/network evidence is available; the project owner accepts operational/commercial exposure before real-customer operation. None prevents completing the current documentation stage.
